intro.speaker: Tam
intro.text: You came off the prison ship, didn't you? I went down to the wreck at low tide to look, and I lost my whistle. Da carved it from a gull's wing-bone. If I go home without it he'll skin me.

accept.speaker: Tam
accept.text: Honest? Thank you! It's small and pale, you'll see it if the sun hits it. Don't let the tide get it first.

reminder.speaker: Tam
reminder.text: Down on the beach, by the wreck. Small, pale, shaped like a little bone flute. Did you look under the wet sand?

return.speaker: Tam
return.text: My whistle! It still works! Here, Da gave me this for helping a stranger once. Take it. And don't tell him I went to the wreck.

after.speaker: Tam
after.text: I'm keeping it on a string now. Want to hear? It sounds just like a gull with the hiccups.
